_about: Task 9 accuracy floors for the document pre-check, measured on corpus/ against labels.json at the shipped OCR_CONFIDENCE_MIN (catalog.js) and NAME_SIMILARITY_MIN (normalize.js). Synthetic corpus: these floors guard against regressions only; they are not a measure of production accuracy. DOC_TYPE/CROSS_MATCH/VALIDITY are scored only on files whose truth READABILITY is PASS (fix round 1). Each floor = the achieved value (4 decimals), no tolerance. Measured with tesseract.js 7.0.0 (package.json ^7.0.0) and the bundled tessdata_fast on the development machine: a breach after an engine, tessdata or CPU change = re-run scripts/document-precheck/accuracy-report.js, read the disagreements, and the operator decides. Ratchet (the project rules): raising a floor is normal; lowering one, or raising unreadableRateMax, is the operator's call with a the change log entry. Reasoning and the sweep: evidence/document-precheck-task-9/INDEX.md.
